cautions.message: Player age 39. Pension payable as early as 55; deferring to 65 increases monthly amount.
Tuition Assistance window is typically within ~72 months of last game. Confirm exact Plan Year rules.
Address must be current; otherwise payment may be delayed or lost.
Application timing matters relative to other disability benefits.
Life insurance ends at age 55 or pension start.
